SELECT
FROM flow_instance i INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN workflow_category c ON c.category_code = d.category AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CAST(u.id AS CHAR) = i.create_by AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_metadata m ON m.instance_id = i.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.business_id = #{businessId} AND i.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.instance_id, t.definition_id, i.business_id, COALESCE(m.business_code, d.flow_code) AS business_code, COALESCE(m.business_title, i.business_id) AS business_title, d.flow_code, d.flow_name, t.node_code, t.node_name, t.flow_status, t.form_custom, t.form_path, n.any_node_skip AS allowed_reject_node_code, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = t.definition_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN flow_node n ON n.definition_id = t.definition_id AND n.node_code = t.node_code AND n.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_metadata m ON m.instance_id = i.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = '0'

SELECT h.id AS history_id, h.task_id, h.instance_id, h.node_type, h.node_code, h.node_name, h.target_node_code, h.target_node_name, h.approver AS approver_id, u.nick_name AS approver_name, h.skip_type, h.flow_status, h.message, h.ext AS attachment_ref, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM flow_his_task h LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CAST(u.id AS CHAR) = h.approver AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE h.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND h.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY h.create_time ASC, h.id ASC

SELECT id FROM flow_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM flow_his_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT t.id AS task_id, t.instance_id, t.definition_id, i.business_id, COALESCE(m.business_code, d.flow_code) AS business_code, COALESCE(m.business_title, i.business_id) AS business_title, d.flow_code, d.flow_name, t.node_code, t.node_name, t.flow_status, t.form_custom, t.form_path, n.any_node_skip AS allowed_reject_node_code, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = t.definition_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN flow_node n ON n.definition_id = t.definition_id AND n.node_code = t.node_code AND n.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_metadata m ON m.instance_id = i.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.node_type = 1
AND d.flow_code = #{query.flowCode}
AND (i.business_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.business_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT h.task_id, h.id AS history_id, h.instance_id, h.definition_id, i.business_id, COALESCE(m.business_code, d.flow_code) AS business_code, COALESCE(m.business_title, i.business_id) AS business_title, d.flow_code, d.flow_name, h.node_code, h.node_name, h.flow_status, h.form_custom, h.form_path, h.approver AS approver_id, u.nick_name AS approver_name, h.message, h.ext AS attachment_ref, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM flow_his_task h INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = h.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = h.definition_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON CAST(u.id AS CHAR) = h.approver AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_metadata m ON m.instance_id = i.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE h.del_flag = '0' AND h.node_type = 1
AND d.flow_code = #{query.flowCode}
AND (i.business_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.business_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR h.node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY h.update_time DESC, h.id DESC

SELECT cp.id AS copy_id, cp.instance_id, cp.history_task_id, cp.business_id, COALESCE(m.business_code, d.flow_code) AS business_code, COALESCE(m.business_title, cp.business_id) AS business_title, d.flow_code, d.flow_name, cp.source_node_code, cp.source_node_name, cp.message, cp.attachment_ref, cp.create_time FROM workflow_task_copy cp INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = cp.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN workflow_instance_metadata m ON m.instance_id = cp.instance_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cp.recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND cp.is_deleted = 0
AND d.flow_code = #{query.flowCode}
AND (cp.business_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.business_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY cp.create_time DESC, cp.id DESC
